core_capabilities: Capture, filter, clone, or delete leads and convert a qualified lead into selected account, contact, and opportunity records.
Create or delete sales opportunities and maintain their amount, stage, probability, close date, and next step.
Create or delete customer-support cases and update their subject, status, priority, origin, and closure state.
Create scheduled CRM events and review them by month and in an upcoming-events list.
Review aggregate lead, account, opportunity, case, pipeline-stage, opportunity-value, and top-account reports.
secondary_capabilities: Create and maintain customer accounts and their related contacts.
Collaborate in an internal feed by publishing posts, commenting, and liking posts.
Upload, preview, open or download, share by copied link, and delete CRM files.
Search across leads, accounts, contacts, and opportunities and open matching records.
Update the current user's profile and save timezone, locale, and light or dark theme preferences.
